title: First, check the data label
text: DEMO DATA · SYNTHETIC means the lab is teaching with generated numbers. Its dates and changes are not evidence of an actual flood.
label: Start with the evidence

title: Choose Before and After
text: Choose an earlier and a later frame. The timeline plays stored frames; it does not create observations between dates. T1 to T6 are frame labels.
label: Dates and timeline

title: Set the change threshold
text: The threshold is the minimum absolute radar difference to mark a candidate. A higher threshold usually selects fewer cells. It is not a confidence percentage.
label: Change threshold · dB

title: Understand smoothing
text: The 3 × 3 option averages nearby valid measurements in linear power, then displays them in dB. It can reduce local variation but also blur small features.
label: 3 × 3 mean in linear power

title: Run, then read the result
text: Candidate cells crossed the threshold. Mean signed change describes the average direction. Zero candidates can coexist with a nonzero mean when changes are below the threshold.
label: Run analysis · Change DNA

title: Check what is still unknown
text: Not available is not zero. Review sources, exclusions and limitations in the receipts. Ask the data explains available evidence using fixed templates; it cannot confirm a flood.
label: Inspect evidence · Ask the data
